audit.why: All seven rows Sylas in full, content and packet — a favoured lane where dodging one Light Binding opens every all-in. No chart edits needed.
Spikes: level 3 Abscond+Q gap-close, 6 (Hijack Final Spark or Abduct through it), first item deletes her, late flank threat. Content spikes[] covers all four.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two fields claimed Petricite Burst 'shields' — it is bonus damage plus attack speed, no shield exists; wants.you[1] called Prismatic Barrier her E (it is W); dosFull[1].t invented a 'post-combo silence' Lux does not have; no digit in breakdown.cooldowns; widespread misgendering; two bleed bullets.
audit.why: Riot's text: Petricite Burst stores empowered-auto charges only. Lux W Prismatic Barrier (12s rank 1) is the shield to bait; Q Light Binding is 10s flat and minion-blockable; she has no silence.
audit.corrected: Shield and silence fabrications removed, slot fixed, numbers added, pronouns and bleed fixed.

edits.before: With items you only get stronger: one E Abduct flank onto an immobile mage is a kill before her team can react, and your Petricite Burst shielding blunts her long-range Final Spark poke. She must land a binding to have any chance, so respect that one cooldown and the fight is yours. Roam freely on your prio — Lux can't punish a lost wave, and your R Hijack makes you a threat at every objective.
